For spherical grains, the specific-surface relation is:

**\( S_s = \dfrac{6}{D_p} \)**

For **\( D_p = 0.0002 \, \text{m} \)**:

\[
S_s = \frac{6}{0.0002} = 30000 \ \text{m}^{-1}
\]

So, **\( S_s = 3.0 \times 10^4 \, \text{1/m} \)**.
